_about: The job interview (D42, SHARE-DESIGN phase 3): what the person wants, so Claude can write their scan (data/SCAN.md) and sort every job into want = ideal / good / fallback, or leave it out. interview.js builds the screens from this; app/person.py checks saved answers against it. Kinds: pick (one), multi (several), text, grid (each row one of the columns), sort (each card one tier).

rounds.title: The work itself
rounds.lede: What you'd like your days to be made of.

questions.label: Most of your day, up to three
options: At a desk with data or computers

questions.label: Any other fields, or your top three in order
In past jobs or school, what did you most enjoy doing?
Where would you like to be in five years?
Jobs you'd take just for the income right now (they'll count as fallback)

rounds.title: Place and setting
rounds.lede: Where, and what kind of workplace.

questions.label: Would you move for the right job?
Getting there
options: No licence: transit, bike or walking

rounds.title: Hours and money
rounds.lede: What you need, and what you'd rather avoid.

questions.label: Lowest pay you'd take (an hourly or yearly figure)
How soon do you need income?

rounds.title: How far to reach
rounds.lede: Stretch jobs: ones you want but don't fully qualify for on paper.

questions.label: When a job asks for more experience than you have
When it asks for a degree or certificate you don't have
Certificates, licences or exams you have or are working on
Which would you rather apply to first?
options: An ideal job I'm under-qualified for
An OK job I'd likely get

rounds.title: Hard no's
rounds.lede: Jobs with any of these never reach your tracker.

questions.label: Never
options: Travel over a quarter of the time

questions.label: Words in a job title that mean no (for example: Senior, Manager)

rounds.title: Sort some jobs (optional)
rounds.lede: One tap each. This catches what's hard to put into words. Skip it if you like.
